groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Let's Communicate in a Different Way!

options.text: a huge part of our daily communication
is feeling in need of privacy
to stay connected with friends and family

sentences.full_sentence: Nonverbal signals make up a huge part of our daily communication
sentences.translation: تشكل الإشارات غير اللفظية جزءاً كبيراً من تواصلنا اليومي

sentences.start: Our facial expressions and body movements can
sentences.full_sentence: Our facial expressions and body movements can convey volumes of information
sentences.translation: يمكن لتعبيرات وجهنا وحركات أجسامنا أن تنقل كميات هائلة من المعلومات

sentences.start: Crossed legs can indicate that a person
sentences.full_sentence: Crossed legs can indicate that a person is feeling in need of privacy
sentences.translation: تشير الأرجل المتقاطعة إلى أن الشخص يشعر بالحاجة إلى الخصوصية

sentences.full_sentence: A smile may indicate approval or happiness
sentences.translation: قد تشير الابتسامة إلى الموافقة أو السعادة

sentences.start: When I started travelling, one of my favourite things to do was
sentences.full_sentence: When I started travelling, one of my favourite things to do was to stay connected with friends and family
sentences.translation: عندما بدأت السفر، كان أحد الأشياء المفضلة لدي هو البقاء على تواصل مع الأصدقاء والعائلة

groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Do Animals Have a Language?

options.text: a bird singing a song or a dog wagging its tail when excited
he gave a smart answer to a very difficult quiz
to respond to actual words but the tone in which it is said

sentences.start: Animals show signs of communication such as
sentences.full_sentence: Animals show signs of communication such as a bird singing a song or a dog wagging its tail when excited
sentences.translation: تظهر الحيوانات علامات تواصل مثل طائر يغني أو كلب يهز ذيله عندما يكون متحمساً

sentences.start: Dogs can be trained to follow certain commands such as
sentences.full_sentence: Dogs can be trained to follow certain commands such as "sit", "come" and "roll over"
sentences.translation: يمكن تدريب الكلاب على اتباع أوامر معينة مثل "اجلس"، "تعال" و "تمرغ"

sentences.start: Human language is creative and consists of
sentences.full_sentence: Human language is creative and consists of unique characteristics
sentences.translation: اللغة البشرية إبداعية وتتكون من خصائص فريدة

sentences.start: Although animals do not have a true language like humans,
sentences.full_sentence: Although animals do not have a true language like humans, they can still communicate
sentences.translation: على الرغم من أن الحيوانات لا تملك لغة حقيقية مثل البشر، إلا أنها لا تزال تستطيع التواصل

sentences.full_sentence: The student was very intellectual; he gave a smart answer to a very difficult quiz
sentences.translation: كان الطالب مثقفاً جداً؛ فقد أعطى إجابة ذكية لاختبار صعب جداً
